title: Rabbi Avin or Ravin bar Sheva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Chullin 86a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.86a.4) mentions him saying, “Since the exiles came up, the meteors ceased,” etc. Hyman considers it very likely that he came from the Land of Israel, bringing the tradition known about Rabbi Chiya and his sons, and descended to Babylonia with the scholars who traveled between the lands. [Chullin 48a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.48a.3) has Rava saying, “Ravin bar Sheva explained it to me.”[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Chullin 86a gives Ravin bar Abba as an alternative to Rabbi Avin bar Shava in transmitting the tradition. Hyman infers the speaker’s origin and journey. Compare [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=187&lang=en).
